notes.title: New B&C Version 1.2
notes.notes:
[b]New missions[/b]
- New US Navy scenario:  Operation Black (Conquer Enemy Major Ports)
- New Royal Navy scenario:  Task Force 1942   (Destroy Fleet Destroyers)

[b]Improved campaigns[/b]
- US Navy campaign extended for one mission: Silent Hunt (now 15 missions in total)
- German Kriegsmarine Campaign extended for two missions: Luftwaffe Atlantic and Germans On Pacific (What If Scenario)
- Royal Navy Campaign extended for one mission: Task Force 1942
- Imperial Japan Navy Campaign extended for one mission: Imperial Navy I

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33864483/0dd87cf436cf6e42318411ee4cdbb2845d201d65.png[/img]

[b]Zoom Map[/b]
- New Zoom Screen added: tactical map now can be zoomed

[b]Minor updates[/b]
- Improved German Kriegsmarine mission Skagerrak (port artillery defense added)
- Bigger Unit class marks on tactical and zoom maps
